test_title: PYST 05: SSC Stenographer - English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 11 Dec 2024 - Shift 2)
subject: english
question: Which of the following statements is not true according to the passage?

options.text: Physical beauty is more impressive than inner beauty.
One visualises according to his idea of beauty

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage emphasizes that beauty is an open-ended and subjective concept.
 
• It states that beauty cannot be bound or defined, making it similar to love.
 
• It also mentions that one visualizes beauty according to their own idea of it.
 
• However, the passage does not suggest that physical beauty is more impressive than inner beauty.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2:** The passage explicitly states that one visualizes beauty based on their own perception.
 
• **Option 3:** The passage describes beauty as an open-ended idea, reinforcing its indefinable nature.
 
• **Option 4:** The passage draws a direct comparison between beauty and love, stating that both are abstract and can only be felt.
